name: 🔌ELECTRICITY🔥Bricklayer
desc:
🧱 Bricklayer 🧱

UPDATE 4 IS OUT!

- Added electricity with logic, bulbs, wiring & more 💡
- Added private mode, to hide other's builds 🔒
- Increased save size from 612 items to 200,000 items per slot 💾
- Added drywall and insulation 🪚
- Added settings (changeable gui size & more) ⚙️
- Added new customizable bricks gamepass (40 Robux) 🧱
- Added another moving system
- Added snap movement
- Added Autosaving
- Made colors saveable & hex codes can now be typed in

Lay bricks, build walls, and become the best bricklayer! 🔨🏗️

Playable on:
📱 Mobile
💻 PC
🎮 Console

TAGS: Brick, Bricklayer, Building, Construction, Simulator, Builder, Welding, Engineering

llm.loop: lay bricks, cut and weld materials -> build walls and structures freely
llm.objectives: become the best bricklayer; build whatever you want
llm.thumbnails: brick structures on a flat baseplate, small brick house, title logo
llm.complexity_notes: building tools with snapping/cutting, physics bricks; flat map
